title: Crazy Rich Asians
score_note: chemistry, the bff lane and the mahjong gesture carry it

beats.name: FIRST CLASS TO SINGAPORE
cap: nick admits on the plane that his family is
wealthy; rachel trusts him and boards
beats.tag: SETUP — the secret he has been keeping

beats.name: PEIK LIN'S HOUSE
cap: peik lin explains how rich the youngs are
and drives rachel to the family estate
beats.tag: EXPOSITION — the scale of the family fortune

beats.name: DINNER AT THE YOUNG ESTATE
cap: eleanor disapproves and the cousins quiz her;
astrid learns michael is unfaithful
beats.tag: THE VERDICT — she is not what he needs

beats.name: THE PARTIES
cap: a dead fish and a hateful note at the
bachelorette; nick tells colin he'll propose
beats.tag: PARALLEL — the women close ranks, the men doubt

beats.name: DUMPLINGS AND THE RING
cap: eleanor says rachel will never be good
enough; her own ring was made, not given
beats.tag: WARNING — what marrying in would cost her

beats.name: THE WEDDING
cap: a makeover, then rachel confronts amanda and
charms the guests; astrid faces michael
beats.tag: SPECTACLE — rachel holds the room at last

beats.name: THE RECEPTION
cap: a private eye found rachel's father alive
and her birth a lie; the family strikes
beats.tag: EXPOSURE — the family strikes at her past

beats.name: KERRY ARRIVES
cap: nick flies rachel's mother in and tells the
truth; rachel refuses his proposal
beats.tag: GESTURE — he gives up his family, and she says no

beats.name: ASTRID LEAVES MICHAEL
cap: astrid moves out with cassian and names
his insecurity as the cause

beats.name: MAHJONG WITH ELEANOR
cap: rachel hands eleanor the winning mahjong
tile, proving she could have kept it
beats.tag: GESTURE — game theory used as an act of love

beats.name: THE ENGAGEMENT
cap: nick proposes with his mother's ring; eleanor
nods from across the room
beats.tag: RESOLUTION — approval, on her own terms
